newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Cash cattle market strong but boxed beef values down further.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Higher corn futures call and lower index but may follow live cattle.
LIVE HOGS - Up 0.300 to off 0.100 cent. Cash markets remain very strong. Trade may turn uneven ahead of hog report.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Cash product remains strong despite larger kills.
